How Voting Works

Voting Process

  1. 1Visit our Vote page and click on each voting site

  4. 4Join our server to claim your rewards
  5. 5Return every 24 hours to vote again

Pro Tip: Set a daily reminder to maximize your rewards!

Vote Reset Times

  • Daily Reset: Midnight GMT+6 (Asia/Dhaka)

/rules.main:
Server Rules

To ensure everyone has a great time on our server, please follow these rules.

Important:

Breaking these rules may result in warnings, temporary bans, or permanent bans depending on the severity and frequency of the offense.

General Conduct
  • Be respectful to all players and staff members.
  • No harassment, bullying, discrimination, or hate speech.
  • No excessive swearing or inappropriate language.
  • No spamming or flooding chat with messages.
  • No advertising other servers or websites.
  • No discussing political or controversial topics.
  • Bangla and English is the primary language in public chat.
Gameplay Rules
  • No griefing or destroying other players' builds.
  • No stealing items from other players.
  • No using hacks, cheats, or unauthorized mods.
  • No exploiting glitches or bugs in the game.
  • PvP is only allowed in designated areas.
  • No building offensive or inappropriate structures.
  • Respect the personal space of other players.
Server Specific Rules
  • No building lag machines or devices that harm server performance.
  • No automated farming with AFK mechanisms that overload the server.
  • Keep redstone contraptions reasonable in size and complexity.
  • No using multiple accounts to gain additional voting rewards.
  • Do not bypass AFK kick mechanisms.
  • Staff instructions must be followed at all times.
  • No claiming excessively large land areas on the server.
Discord & Community Rules
  • All server rules apply to our Discord server as well.
  • Use appropriate channels for different topics.
  • No NSFW content in any channel or direct message.
  • Do not ping staff unnecessarily.
  • No voice chat spam or earrape.
  • Follow specific rules posted in Discord channel descriptions.
  • Report rule violations to staff instead of confronting players.
Voting & Rewards Rules
  • Always use your exact in-game username when voting.
  • Do not use VPNs or proxies to bypass vote limitations.
  • Do not create multiple accounts to vote multiple times.
  • Do not sell or trade vote rewards for real money.
  • Report any issues with voting to staff members.
  • Attempting to manipulate the voting system will result in a ban.
  • Vote rewards are non-transferable between accounts.
Ban Appeal Process
  • If you believe you were banned unfairly, you may submit an appeal through our Discord server.
  • Include your Minecraft username and when you were banned.
  • Include the reason for ban (if known).
  • Provide your explanation of the situation.
  • Explain why you should be unbanned.
  • Appeals are reviewed by our admin team. Please allow up to 48 hours for a response.

Rule Changes

These rules may be updated at any time without notice. It's your responsibility to stay informed about the current rules.

Last updated: November 8, 2026
